# Transporeon: Digital Transport Documents (eCMR) API

- **Product:** Transporeon: Digital Transport Documents (eCMR) API (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** HTTP basic. Declared security schemes: basic.
- **Access:** Transporeon eCMR customers.
- **To call it you would need:** Transporeon eCMR credentials for api.transporeon.com/edc.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.test.transporeon.com/edc`, `https://api.transporeon.com/edc`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/transporeon-edc-swagger-json](https://api.transporeon.com/edc/swagger.json) (Digital Transport Documents API, version 1.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/27230573/API+for+Digital+Transport+Documents+-+eCMR.

## Documents

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DELETE` | `/v1/documents/{id}` | `reference` | Remove the document by provided Id | id* (path) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/documents/{id}/attachments/{attachmentId}` | `reference` | Delete an attachment of a document. Only allowed when document status is NEW. | id* (path); attachmentId* (path) |
| `GET` | `/v1/documents` | `reference` | Get paginated list of documents with sorting and filtering | page (query); size (query); sort (query); filter* (query) |
| `GET` | `/v1/documents/ids` | `reference` | Retrieve the document IDs that have been created, updated, or removed since the last time the interface was accessed for the specified context company. |  |
| `GET` | `/v1/documents/{id}` | `reference` | Get details of a document with provided Id | id* (path) |
| `GET` | `/v1/documents/{id}/attachments/{attachmentId}` | `reference` | Get an attachment of a document by document id and attachment id | id* (path); attachmentId* (path) |
| `GET` | `/v1/documents/{id}/pdf` | `reference` | Get PDF of a document with provided Id | id* (path) |
| `GET` | `/v1/documents/{id}/sharing` | `excluded`: safety: signs in, issues, renews, validates or revokes credentials, or stores a password or client secret; agents never handle credentials (as for Trimble Identity) | Get sharing data of a document with provided Id | id* (path) |
| `GET` | `/v1/documents/{id}/sharing/{tokenType}` | `excluded`: safety: signs in, issues, renews, validates or revokes credentials, or stores a password or client secret; agents never handle credentials (as for Trimble Identity) | Get sharing data of a document with provided Id | id* (path); tokenType* (path) |
| `GET` | `/v1/documents/{id}/signature/{role}` | `reference` | Get signature of a document with provided Id and role | id* (path); role* (path) |

## eCMR

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/documents/ecmr` | `reference` | Create a new eCMR document | body: application/json |
| `POST` | `/v1/documents/ecmr/{id}/sign` | `reference` | Sign an eCMR or CDP document | id* (path); body: application/json |
| `PUT` | `/v1/documents/ecmr/{id}` | `reference` | Update an eCMR, CDP, or DeCA document | id* (path); body: application/json |
